description.blurb: 4179 Toutatis is an elongated asteroid and slow rotator, classified as near-Earth object and potentially hazardous asteroid of the Apollo and Alinda group, approximately 2.5 kilometers in diameter.
description.more: Toutatis is not a monolith, but most likely a coalescence of shattered fragments. This bifurcated asteroid is shown to be mainly consisting of a head (small lobe) and a body (large lobe).The Chinese lunar probe Chang'e 2 departed from the Sun–Earth L2 point in April of 2012and made a flyby of Toutatis on December 13th, 2012, with the closest approach being 3.2 kilometers and a relative velocity of 10.73 km/s, exactly when Toutatis was near its closest approach to Earth. It took several pictures of the asteroid, revealing it to be a dusty red/orange color.
